jobs.title: IN Career:Night Sort Warehouse Associate in East Chicago | Hiring
jobs.description:
Local Job Overview: East Chicago

Job Title: Night Sort Warehouse Associate Company: UPS Location: East Chicago, IN

Salary: $23-$27/Hour (approx. $30.7k/Year) Benefits: A comprehensive benefits package is included. Clear growth pathways at our East Chicago office.

Position Scope

Core objectives involve your professional skills in Package Logistics.

  • This East Chicago-based role is an excellent opportunity for professionals skilled in relevant skills.
  • Our UPS team in East Chicago, IN is growing.
  • Benefit from working in East Chicago, a key hub for the Package Logistics industry.

About UPS & Our Culture

While most of the city powers down for the night, UPS powers up. The night sort is the highest-volume, highest-urgency shift in our entire package center operation — the window where the day's accumulated commercial and residential pickups are sorted and loaded onto linehaul trailers that must depart on hard schedules before dawn. If you are a night owl searching for UPS warehouse jobs that pair serious overnight pay differentials with the intensity of a world-class sort operation, our night sort shift is the most financially rewarding entry-level window in our entire logistics careers portfolio.

What Our Team Says (Employee Reviews)

"The night sort is not for people who want to ease into their shift — it is full speed from the moment the belt starts. But the overnight differential genuinely adds up to a paycheck that beats every comparable warehouse job in this area. I am home by 3 AM, my days are completely free, and the Earn & Learn program is funding my degree while I sleep. UPS night sort is the best-kept secret in the local job market." - Current Night Sort Warehouse Associate, Philadelphia, PA.

Role Overview & Responsibilities

As a UPS Night Sort Warehouse Associate, you process the facility's peak nightly commercial pickup volume during the late-night sort window, working at sustained high intensity to clear the sort floor before hard linehaul trailer departure deadlines inside our package center.

  • High-Volume Commercial Sort Processing: Sort the dense volume of business pickup packages collected by UPS drivers throughout the afternoon, reading destination labels and routing every parcel accurately to its correct outbound trailer lane at peak belt speed.
  • Linehaul Trailer Loading: Load completed outbound pallets and loose packages onto 53-foot linehaul trailers under hard departure window constraints, maximizing trailer cube while maintaining load quality standards that prevent damage during long-distance transport.
  • Departure Deadline Compliance: Work with precise awareness of each trailer's hard departure time, prioritizing the loading sequence to ensure every linehaul trailer is sealed, documented, and released to the yard before its scheduled pull time.

Benefits & Perks

Night Sort Warehouse Associates earn a substantial overnight shift differential on top of the Teamsters base hourly wage — one of the highest total hourly rates available at the entry level across all warehouse jobs in the UPS network. Full Teamsters medical, dental, vision, pension, UPS Earn & Learn tuition funding, and paid personal time are included from day one of eligibility.

jobs.description:
Role Based in Chicago

Key Information

  • Employer: UPS (Hiring in Chicago)
  • Salary: $20-$24/Hour (approx. $46.2k/Year)
  • Benefits: A competitive compensation package is offered.
  • Job Title: Full-time Night Shift Warehouse Unloader (Gig/Contract)
  • Flexible contract/gig opportunity in Chicago.
  • Based in: Chicago, IL (a vibrant local hub)
  • Apply your your professional skills skills at our Chicago location.
  • This Chicago-based role is an excellent opportunity for professionals skilled in relevant skills.
  • Our UPS team in Chicago, IL is growing.
  • Benefit from working in Chicago, a key hub for the Package Logistics industry.

About UPS & Our Culture

The night shift unload is the most physically demanding and most financially rewarding entry-level position in the UPS warehouse network. Our Full-Time Night Shift Unloaders are the associates who set the entire sort operation in motion every evening — pulling packages from trailers at sustained speed so that the entire downstream sort, load, and dispatch chain can execute without interruption. If you are seeking full-time night shift warehouse jobs that pay a premium for working hours others avoid, reward physical effort with contractually guaranteed union wages, and open the door to one of the most financially powerful blue-collar careers in America, this is the opportunity you have been looking for.

What Our Team Says (Employee Reviews)

"I specifically wanted a full-time night shift because I do not want to deal with traffic and I am naturally a night person. The UPS overnight differential on top of the full-time union wage makes my take-home pay genuinely outstanding for the skill level required to start. I have been here four years, I make more than most of my college-educated friends, and I am currently in the line for a full-time driver position. Full-time night shift warehouse jobs do not get better than this." - Current Full-Time Night Shift Unloader, Memphis, TN.

Role Overview & Responsibilities

As a UPS Full-Time Night Shift Warehouse Unloader, you work an 8-hour overnight shift inside our package center, leading the high-velocity inbound unload operation that processes all trailers arriving during the night sort window and sets up the entire sort floor for the day ahead.

  • High-Speed Trailer Unloading: Pull packages from fully loaded 53-foot inbound trailers at a sustained rate across a full 8-hour shift, placing every parcel label-side up on the inbound conveyor belt to maintain sort floor throughput targets through the peak overnight window.
  • Inbound Freight Verification: Identify and flag trailer shortages, damaged freight, and hazmat packages at the point of unload before any problem item enters the main sort flow, protecting downstream sort accuracy and compliance.
  • Dock Safety Leadership: Model UPS safety protocols — trailer chocking, dock plate seating, and heavy-lift team technique — for newer associates in the unload area, setting the standard that keeps the night shift injury-free shift after shift.

Benefits & Perks

UPS Full-Time Night Shift Unloaders earn a significant overnight shift differential stacked on top of the full-time Teamsters union base wage — one of the highest total hourly rates available in the package logistics industry without a CDL. Full medical, dental, and vision benefits, a defined-benefit pension, paid vacation, sick time, paid holidays, and UPS Earn & Learn tuition assistance are all included. Weekly paychecks are direct-deposited every Friday.

jobs.description:
This job was posted by https://illinoisjoblink.illinois.gov : For more

Information, Please See

https://illinoisjoblink.illinois.gov/jobs/13647394

**Join a Mission-Driven Team**

Do you have a heart for service, a commitment to safety, and a desire to

make a meaningful impact? Moody Bible Institute is seeking a**Public

Safety Officer**to help create a secure and welcoming environment for

our students, employees, residents, and guests on our Chicago campus. As

part of our Public Safety team, you will play a vital role in protecting

our community while supporting Moody\'s mission of equipping people with

the truth of God\'s Word.

**About Us**

Moody Bible Institute is a Christ-centered higher education and media

ministry dedicated to equipping people with the truth of God\'s Word.

Through trusted biblical teaching, media, and educational resources,

Moody reaches audiences around the world with the gospel and seeks to

make a lasting Kingdom impact.

**The Opportunity**

Reporting to the Chief of Public Safety, the Public Safety Officer is

responsible for maintaining the safety and security of Moody Bible

Institute\'s Chicago campus through proactive patrols, emergency

response, incident management, and community engagement. This role

requires sound judgment, professionalism, and a servant-hearted approach

to serving others.

**What Youll Do**

  • Conduct foot and vehicle patrols to deter and identify security

concerns.

  • Serve as a primary responder to campus incidents, alarms, emergency

calls, and 911 notifications.

  • Assess, manage, and secure incident scenes while coordinating with

emergency responders and city officials.

  • Prepare accurate, timely, and detailed incident reports and related

documentation.

  • Monitor and oversee part-time staff and dispatch operations during

assigned shifts.

  • Enforce campus policies, including parking regulations and access

control procedures.

  • Provide security coverage for campus events and activities.
  • Assist students, employees, and visitors by providing information,

guidance, and support.

  • Issue trespass notices when necessary and respond to unauthorized

access concerns.

  • Provide security escorts, cash transport support, and executive

protection services as assigned.

  • Complete additional departmental duties and special assignments as

directed.

**Key Qualifications**

  • Associate degree or two years of related security, public safety,

law enforcement, military, or customer service experience.

  • Valid driver\'s license with a satisfactory driving record.
  • At least 21 years of age.
  • Strong communication, interpersonal, and report-writing skills.
  • Ability to remain calm and make sound decisions in emergency

situations.

  • Authorized to work in the United States without employer

sponsorship.

**Preferred Qualifications**

  • Bachelors degree in criminal justice or a related field.
  • Illinois PERC Card.
  • Illinois FOID Card.
  • Experience responding to fire, medical, or security incidents.
  • Previous security, law enforcement, campus safety, or military

experience.

**Work Environment**

  • This position is based on Moody Bible Institute\'s downtown Chicago

campus and includes both outdoor and indoor responsibilities.

  • Officers regularly patrol campus on foot and in vehicles, respond to

emergencies, and interact with a diverse campus community.

  • The role requires standing, walking, climbing stairs, and working in

varying weather conditions.

**Schedule**

This position follows an overnight shift schedule, consisting of three

12-hour shifts (6:00 p.m. to 6:00 a.m.) per week, with a rotating fourth

weekend shift as needed.

**What We Offer**

Mission-driven work that impacts lives for Christ.

Supportive and collaborative team environment.
